judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and failing acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`). It completely failed to implement the actual validation logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or add `ajv` to `package.json`. Because the core implementation is missing, the newly added acceptance tests will immediately fail and the test suite is broken. Furthermore, none of the required unit tests (`registry.test.ts`, `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) or documentation updates (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were performed.
